title: Fallbacks are inert outside the web request path
description: I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! is called only from ApplicationController#set_locale. In Sidekiq jobs and other contexts (post_alerter, post_destroyer, db.rake) where I18n.locale is set without ensure_loaded!, fallback locales are never loaded. On non-English default_locale sites, translation keys that exist only in :en resolve to MissingTranslation in emails and notifications.

title: Translation LRU cache key doesn't include the site's default_locale
description: Cache key is key + config.locale + backend.object_id, omitting SiteSetting.default_locale which is per-site and mutable. Multisite: two sites with different default_locales can poison the LRU and serve each other wrong translations. Single-site: an admin changing default_locale leaves stale fallback entries cached until process restart.

title: Uncached fallback list runs a SiteSetting lookup on every translate
description: FallbackLocaleList#[] recomputes [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en] on every call instead of memoizing. I18n.Backend.Fallbacks#translate calls it on every backend lookup, and every interpolated I18n.t(key, count: n) bypasses the LRU cache. Stock implementation memoizes to avoid this overhead.
